dedupe_keys.name: high resolution near surface soil model developed for site response analysis in alameda ca

description: High-Resolution Near-Surface Soil Model Developed for Site Response Analysis in Alameda, CA. is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sanjay Govindjee, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This project describes the development of a high-resolution near-surface soil model for the city of Alemda, CA using SCPT data and local geotechnical reports. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-3xm5-p759. Keywords: Shear-wave velocity, soil strata, liquefaction, kriging. Published 2021-09-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
